title: What the regimes carry
claim: For laws on bits: (1) a cycle of pairwise implications allows exactly the two constant states, one open distinction carried by all its members, and two such loops with one knot on a member of each and a contact form the canonical first-emergence structure, while pairwise clauses never knot two loops; (2) a law keeps a lasting record of loops exactly when it defines a parity knot, exactly when all its polymorphisms are affine; (3) with constants added, it then lacks bounded width, and otherwise has it, so lasting memory coincides with the failure of every bounded level of local reasoning; (4) every pairwise or frozen law is polynomial, so every NP-complete law transmits, and every law NP-complete with constants keeps memory; the transmitting regime splits into forcing (conjunction or disjunction), conservation (affine with minority) and choice (affine without minority, NP-complete with constants); (5) pairwise contradictions are refuted at bounded width while parity charges are not; (6) a cycle of equalities fixes one distinction that only a change of every member flips, while a ring of parity knots keeps every distinction flippable by three changes and holds one knot on all of them. Census of 273 laws generated by one relation on at most three bits: 183 pairwise, 2 frozen, 32 forcing, 2 conservation, 54 choice.
failure_conditions: An implication cycle with other states, or a loop-loop-contact structure that is not the contact's knot or does not free under erasure, or a pairwise join that knots two loops.

A small law where a non-affine ternary polymorphism comes without conjunction, disjunction or majority, where memory and opacity differ, or where an NP-complete law is pairwise, frozen or without memory.
A parity gadget in a law without memory, or parity rings that lose their bit, or Horn rings that exclude a pattern.
A liar cycle not refuted by 3-consistency, or an odd-charge parity network on the five graphs refuted at levels 2-4.
An equality cycle flippable with fewer changes than its length, or a parity ring needing more than three or whose visible relation is not one knot.
foundation_claim_scope: Loops, lasting memory, local transparency, hardness and global cycles across the regimes of laws on bits. No native recurrence beyond the stated reading, no space, no physics.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies implication cycles and the loop-loop-contact structure for three contacts and 200 pairwise joins, the ternary polymorphisms of all 273 small laws (Post fact, memory, opacity, regimes, hardness), parity gadgets, rings, local consistency on liar cycles and five parity networks, and flips on equality cycles and parity rings; five controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and explicit checks; the ring theorem, the cutwidth proof, the ends proof, Post's lattice, the Galois connection, Schaefer's theorem and Feder and Vardi's bounded-width results are cited; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: classical ingredients (Post, Schaefer, Feder and Vardi, strongly connected components); new to the program are loops as pairwise cycles, the identity of lasting memory with opacity, hardness confined to transmission with memory, and the two kinds of universal cycle.
